items.title: Bitcoin Price Tops $65k On 5th Day Of Spot BTC ETF Inflows
items.summary: Bitcoin's price surpassed $65,000, reaching a new August high of $65,340, driven by its fifth consecutive day of net inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, totaling $98.85 million. This resurgence is attributed to easing geopolitical tensions and unexpectedly weak U.S. non-farm payroll data, which lowered expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike. BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC led these inflows, signaling strong institutional confidence in cryptocurrencies.

items.title: KLA (KLAC) Stock Climbs As AI Demand Lifts Margins Despite China Risk
items.summary: KLA (KLAC) stock rose by 2.5% after reporting record quarterly revenue of US$3.66 billion and strong non-GAAP EPS, driven by AI demand and advanced packaging. The company's high gross margins in the low 60s and growing services revenue support a bullish outlook, despite concerns about cyclicality and geopolitical risks related to China.

items.title: AGNC Investment (NASDAQ:AGNC): 13.3% Dividend, Trades 26% Above Last Reported Book Value
items.summary: AGNC Investment (NASDAQ:AGNC) closed Friday at $10.84, with its 13.3% annualized dividend yield. The stock trades 26.3% above its last reported tangible book value from June, yet analysts expect limited share price appreciation with an average price target of $11.06. Upcoming inflation data next week, including CPI and PPI, are crucial as they could impact mortgage asset values and challenge AGNC's current valuation equilibrium.

items.title: Nvidia to invest up to $3 billion in Stargate data center developer Lancium, the Information reports
items.summary: Nvidia plans to invest up to $3 billion in Lancium, a power infrastructure developer behind the Stargate data center campus in Texas, according to The Information. The chipmaker will initially invest $2 billion for a 20% stake, with an option for an additional $1 billion if certain conditions are met. This capital infusion is expected to aid Lancium's expansion and potential IPO in 2027.

(SVAQ) has amended its Business Combination Agreement (BCA) with EigenQ, Inc., primarily revising the "Fully-Diluted Shares" definition, which will impact the ownership allocation of the combined company. items.title: Should Two Harbors’ Broad Index Removals Amid Q2 Profit Swing Require Action From TWO Investors?
items.summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. was recently removed from major Russell and S&P equity indices, including the Russell 2000, Russell 3000, and S&P 600, despite reporting a significant swing to a US$62.25 million net income in Q2 2026 from a previous loss. Investors should focus more on the impending merger with CrossCountry Mortgage, including deal execution, timing of the stub dividend, and any legal delays, rather than the index status, especially given the company's weak dividend coverage and history of losses. The index removals may impact market visibility and liquidity, but the company's valuation remains complex with widely divergent fair value estimates from the community.

items.title: Procter & Gamble (PG) Stock Looks Cheap On Cash Flow While Returns Stay Modest
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) stock appears undervalued based on its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value, which estimates a value of around $199 per share against a current price of $145.79. While its P/E ratio is above the industry average, it's below its broader peer group and a tailored fair P/E, suggesting undervaluation on an earnings basis as well. However, the article highlights mixed signals and ongoing restructuring, including the US$3.8 billion Thorne acquisition, suggesting that the market's caution might be due to execution and cost risks affecting future cash flows.

items.title: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. amends business combination agreement with EigenQ
items.summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ) has amended its business combination agreement with EigenQ, Inc., clarifying the use of Transaction Support Shares for any purpose related to the merger and increasing the post-merger board size from seven to nine members. The equity incentive plan for the combined company will reserve approximately ten percent of outstanding shares. The deal still requires shareholder approval, and SVAQ's stock trades near its 52-week low.

items.title: Silicon Valley Acquisition (NASDAQ: SVAQ) updates EigenQ deal, board and plan
items.summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ) has amended its merger agreement with EigenQ, Inc. to update terms regarding sponsor-held shares, redemption of public shares, board size, and the equity incentive plan. The changes include allowing 2,165,950 sponsor Class B shares for any purpose related to the Business Combination, expanding the PubCo board to 9 directors, and setting the initial equity incentive plan reserve at approximately 10% of the fully-diluted common stock. The merger remains contingent on shareholder approval and SEC effectiveness.

items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Stock Could Be 2% Overvalued Despite African Ratings Deal
items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) stock has dropped 21.9% over the past year, and its valuation presents a mixed picture. While the Excess Returns model suggests the shares are near their intrinsic value, indicating a slight 2.4% overvaluation, traditional earnings multiples, particularly the P/E ratio, suggest the stock is more expensive. This discrepancy highlights a debate among investors on whether to prioritize intrinsic value based on cash flow and returns or market multiples, especially given recent strategic expansions.
